steps.title: Select Your Reading App
steps.content: Choose where your highlights are coming from. We currently support Readwise (CSV), KOReader (JSON), Play Books (HTML/DOCX), and Kindle (PDF). The file type filter below updates automatically based on your selection.

steps.title: Upload Your Export File
steps.content: Select the exported file from your computer. Accepted file types depend on the source you chose: .csv for Readwise, .json for KOReader, .html or .docx for Play Books, and .pdf for Kindle. Maximum file size is 50MB.

steps.title: Start the Import
steps.content: Click to upload and process your file. Each highlight is parsed into an illustration, deduplicated against your existing library, and automatically indexed for hybrid search — including semantic vector search.

steps.title: Review Import Results
steps.content: After processing completes, you will see a summary like "Imported 42 of 50 highlights". The message also shows how many were skipped as duplicates and how many encountered errors.

steps.title: Set Your Default Place
steps.content: While you are on the Settings page, consider setting a default Place and Location. These values pre-fill the Place form when you copy an illustration's content, saving you time when logging where you used a quote.
